add_records_expense.statement: add stores payer, amount, description and participants as an expense in the JSON file.
must_include: record expenses with payer, amount, description, participants

json_persistence.statement: Expenses written by one invocation are read back by a later invocation from the JSON file.

equal_split.statement: Shares among participants differ by at most one cent and sum exactly to the amount.

balances_net.statement: balances prints paid minus owed per person, and the values sum to zero.

greedy_settlement.statement: settle pairs largest debtor with largest creditor; applying the transfers zeroes all balances in at most n-1 transfers.

invalid_input_rejected.statement: Bad amount, empty participants or corrupt JSON exits non-zero and leaves the file unchanged.
must_include: invalid input rejected without changing the file

single_file_stdlib.statement: expense_splitter.py imports only standard library modules.
